improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly stating what Gideon offers and the low entry price. Open Graph tags ensure professional, branded previews when shared on LinkedIn, Facebook, and Twitter—critical for B2B audiences. Including the free trial mention reduces friction and encourages clicks.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Meet Gideon — get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support for your business operations. Try 3 free searches today."
improvements.rationale: This headline immediately communicates what Gideon is (AI assistant) and who it serves (trade and business professionals). The subheading reinforces key value props (instant answers, voice chat, professional support) while creating a clear, low-friction CTA with the free trial offer. The name 'Gideon' adds personality and memorability without sacrificing clarity.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to join GDN AI as a member. Membership starts from just US$2 per day, giving you unlimited access to Gideon's voice chat, your personal workspace, and professional trade and business support. Choose annual billing to save 30 percent.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point—the paywall transition. By clearly explaining what happens next and reinforcing the low entry price and value, it reduces uncertainty and increases conversion likelihood at the critical decision moment.
